title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Qaidi
desc: Suraj returns home to debt and auction. Widowed father and sister die. He kills two, goes to prison, escapes. Police guard Bansilal, shoot to kill Suraj on sight.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.

title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
desc: Five years after her husband vanishes, Vasudha rebuilds life as a single mother and finds love with Aarav. But when Hari unexpectedly returns, her world shatters as love and loyalty collide.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: No Entry
desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: Four teens accidentally film a murder involving a well-known figure and soon find themselves in danger. Ajay, a brave journalist, steps in to help them expose the killers.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Amir Garib
desc: A man lives a dual life, that of a magician and the other as a thief whose motive is to help the needy and poor. He falls in love with a girl.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: Raanjhnaa
desc: Kundan has loved Zoya since childhood, but learns she loves another. When he discovers she lied about her fiance's religion, his heartbreak turns into uncontrollable rage and obsession.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
desc: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.
